description: Add user aliases and an extension system matching gh: ado alias set/list/delete/import ($1 placeholders, --shell via sh/PowerShell, no shadowing built-ins, stored in config.yml) and ado extension install/list/upgrade/remove/exec/create/search/browse (GitHub, Azure DevOps or local sources; script, GitHub Release and Azure Artifacts binaries; checksums, pinning, allowlist, token consent); ado-<name> dispatch with context env vars; author contract docs
